purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (shinryo-koui) processing system - diagnosis/treatment act confirmation screen (component K08)
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system for Japanese clinics. It handles the confirmation screen for medical treatment acts (shinryo-koui), managing input, editing, and validation of treatment records including insurance points, drug quantities, and hospitalization data. It reads/writes parameter files in /var/tmp and coordinates with other ORCA subsystems via COPY-included SPA (scratchpad area) structures.

notable_features: 86 COPY statements for shared data structures and screen definitions
Large SPA (scratchpad area) with OCCURS 800 table for treatment line items
REDEFINES used extensively for multi-format record layouts
Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
441 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
verdict.notes: Japanese comments appear as mojibake because the file is EUC-JP encoded but decoded as latin-1. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese clinics. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~304KB total.
